description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kirimetithenna, Balangoda D/S Division, Ratnapura District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including details about land ownership, extent, encumbrances, and servitude rights. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land registration and property rights, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
